notes: Live evals browse real sites and a full run takes hours, so these prompts bound the run. Eval 2 may open a headed agent-browser window if headless fails the Cloudflare probe. Clean up afterwards: the /tmp/let-vps run folder and any letvps-* agent-browser sessions.

evals.name: asks-for-backend-first
evals.prompt: find me the cheapest european vps on lowendtalk for a minecraft server, 4 cores 8gb, yearly billing
evals.expected_output: Before init or any browser action, the agent checks which browser CLIs are installed and asks the user to choose between ego-browser and agent-browser, with a recommendation and a one-line trade-off for each. Nothing is browsed until the user answers.
assertions: the agent asked which browser backend to use before running ledger.py init or any browser command
only installed backends were offered, with a recommendation
no web page was fetched or opened before the user answered

evals.name: agent-browser-bounded-discovery
evals.setup: agent-browser installed; a desktop session is available in case the Cloudflare probe forces a headed window.
evals.prompt: Run let-vps-scout with agent-browser, but this is a dry run: only read LET offer listing pages 1-2 and the opening post of the first thread listed on page 1, merge the results, then stop, tear the browser down and tell me the run folder.
evals.expected_output: The agent runs `ledger.py init --browser agent-browser`, loads `agent-browser skills get core`, launches one headless host session named letvps-<suffix> (relaunching it headed only if the Cloudflare probe fails), records it, its mode and its CDP URL in STATUS.md, then browses through pinned-tab sessions attached with --cdp (not through the host session). Every open is followed by a wait that rejects the Cloudflare 'Just a moment...' interstitial. Listing and thread text is saved under evidence/, a worker file is merged with ledger.py merge, and teardown releases worker tabs and closes only letvps-* sessions.
assertions: ledger.py init was run with --browser agent-browser and STATUS.md records the backend
agent-browser skills get core was loaded before the first browsing command
one host browser was launched headless first, relaunched headed only if the Cloudflare probe failed, and its mode and CDP URL were recorded in STATUS.md
page browsing used --cdp with --pin-tab sessions, not the host session
each open was followed by a wait that excludes the 'Just a moment' interstitial before extraction
evidence/listings/page-01.txt and page-02.txt contain real listing text, not the Cloudflare interstitial
agent-browser read was never called with a URL
agent-browser close --all was never run, and no letvps-* session remains afterwards

evals.name: resume-legacy-run-uses-ego-browser
evals.setup: A run folder created by v1.0.0 of the skill whose STATUS.md has no 'Browser backend' line.
evals.expected_output: The agent reads STATUS.md, sees no recorded backend, treats the run as ego-browser without asking the user to choose, and continues from the recorded resume point.
assertions: the agent did not ask the user to choose a backend
the agent continued with ego-browser and reused the recorded TaskSpace if it still exists
